title: A binary search tree
description:
Store words in a BST and look them up.

```
insert: mango apple pear banana cherry
sorted: apple banana cherry mango pear
find cherry: yes (depth 3)
find kiwi: no
min apple, max pear, height 4
```
hints: Insert by walking a `std::unique_ptr<Node>*` down to an empty slot: `auto* slot{&m_root}; while (*slot) slot = word < (*slot)->word ? &(*slot)->left : &(*slot)->right;` (lesson 4.02).
Height is 1 plus the larger height of the children; an empty tree has height 0.
stretch: Insert the words in sorted order and see the tree become a list (height 5).
